purpose: Test the frozen replacement model NL1_NUMERIC_CLASS_STYLE_L2_V1 against frozen B1a on a new meeting-disjoint historical universe whose target outcomes were not used in replacement-model development or selection.
selection_rule: The five meeting IDs above are frozen before any target result scoring for this validation.
For each fixed meeting, enumerate day indices 01,02,03,04 and race numbers 01..12 in listed-meeting/day/race order.
During selection, use only the existing fail-closed PRE parser required by frozen B1a. A candidate enters iff all mandatory PRE rider fields parse successfully.
Retain every PRE-complete candidate. Do not stop at a favorable count, replace after outcomes, or delete unfavorable races.

Before prediction lock, fail closed if any fixed validation meeting collides with the seed/temporal batches, independent-meeting batch3, coverage-balanced batch4, regime-validation batch5, regime-confirmation batch6, the new-lineage development meetings, or explicitly known smaller scored historical meetings.
DEV2000 is not queried or reused as fresh validation evidence. ECON_HOLDOUT1000 remains sealed.

Require at least 120 successfully frozen races and PRE-complete representation from all five fixed meetings; otherwise fail closed before dedicated result scoring and do not alter the rule after outcome access.
Freeze the complete PRE inputs plus both NL1 and B1a probabilities/rankings for every selected race before dedicated target result-page scoring.
After prediction lock, score every frozen race for which the result parser succeeds. Any result-fetch/parser failure is retained explicitly and is never silently substituted.
No odds or payout data are required or used for this probability/ranking validation.

interpretability_gate_after_scoring.if_gate_fails: INCONCLUSIVE_RESULT_COVERAGE; do not declare model pass/fail and do not replace failed results after outcome access

primary_validation_criteria.C1_POOLED_LOG_LOSS: NL1 mean multiclass log loss must be at least 0.03 lower than B1a on the identical scored races.
primary_validation_criteria.C2_MEETING_STABILITY: NL1 must have lower mean log loss than B1a in at least 3 of the 5 fixed validation meetings.
primary_validation_criteria.C3_TOP3_NONINFERIORITY: NL1 winner Top3 rate must be no more than 0.02 below B1a on the identical scored races.
primary_validation_criteria.C4_TOP1_NONINFERIORITY: NL1 Top1 accuracy must be no more than 0.02 below B1a on the identical scored races.

overall_decision_rule.PASS_UNTOUCHED_VALIDATION: interpretability gate passes and C1, C2, C3 and C4 all pass
overall_decision_rule.FAIL_UNTOUCHED_VALIDATION: interpretability gate passes and at least one of C1, C2, C3 or C4 fails
